I initially went to this clinic for just my annual teeth cleaning and had braces done elsewhere. My teeth were fine, no pain, no impacted teeth. The dentist examined me and said the dental filling was worn down. I trusted him. However, after having the new filling done here, my root canal became inflamed to the point where I couldn't chew. X-rays showed the root canal was normal, but the dentist couldn't find the cause of the pain. In the end, after a little over a month, the clinic only offered a 40% discount on the root canal treatment, requiring treatment from a specialist. I was completely confused; I came in perfectly fine and left with a severely inflamed root canal.
